judge.corpora_note: Era note (per this brief): R5007/R5008 are German, dated 1842-1843. Neither wired German corpus fits well -- de16 (LANG_CORPORA's default, composed_enhg.txt) is Early New High German, 15th-16th c., about 300 years too early; de20 is 1880-1940 Gutenberg prose (GOLD-C, 25 Sept 2026), 40-100 years too late. de20 is named here as the nearer of the two (a 19th-century official/diplomatic register sits closer to 1880-1940 literary German than to 1500s German), not as a genuine match; treat any FAIL or PASS against this judge as evidence of unknown reliability on era grounds alone (CLAUDE.md's pt17/pt18 lesson), and downgrade further if a 19th-century German corpus becomes available. R5005/R5006 are French (1841-1842); no French judge run is proposed here since French plaintext was never reached in this job.
